enchantment.jeienchantmentinfo.bane_of_a: Increases damage and applies Slowness IV to arthropod mobs (spiders, cave spiders, silverfish, endermites & bees).
enchantment.jeienchantmentinfo.channelin: During thunderstorms, a thrown trident summons a lightning bolt on the target when hitting it.
enchantment.jeienchantmentinfo.binding_c: Items can only be removed from armor slots via breaking or death.
enchantment.jeienchantmentinfo.efficienc: Increases tool speed, as well as the chance for axes to disable shields.
enchantment.jeienchantmentinfo.fire_prot: Reduces fire damage and burn time.
enchantment.jeienchantmentinfo.flame.des: Arrows set mobs/players on fire, and ignite TNT, campfires, and candles.
enchantment.jeienchantmentinfo.fortune.d: Increases the amount of most block drops.
enchantment.jeienchantmentinfo.frost_wal: Freezes water under foot to allow walking on water, and prevents damage from walking on magma blocks and campfires.
enchantment.jeienchantmentinfo.luck_of_t: Increases rate of catching treasure, rather than junk.
enchantment.jeienchantmentinfo.mending.d: Causes collected XP orbs to repair held items, rather than increasing experience.
enchantment.jeienchantmentinfo.multishot: Simultaneously shoots 3 arrows at the cost of one.
Arrows pass through shields and multiple entities.
enchantment.jeienchantmentinfo.riptide.d: Trident launches player with itself when thrown while in water or rain.
enchantment.jeienchantmentinfo.soul_spee: Increases movement speed on soul sand and soul soil.
enchantment.jeienchantmentinfo.thorns.de: Taking damage causes the attacker to also take damage, at the cost of reducing item durability.
